notes.title: Patch Notes V1.0.6
notes.content:
[p][b]Thank you for playing HUNTER×HUNTER NEN×IMPACT.
Today, we have released a new patch with the following updates to improve your gameplay experience.[/b][/p][h3]■Patch Details (V1.0.6)[/h3][list][*][p][b]Optimization of processes and adjustment of data processing volume to address an issue identified in certain network environments, where an excessive number of rollback frames were being generated.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]■Platforms[/h3][list][*][p][b]PlayStation®5[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam®[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]■Notes[/h3][p][b]Please update to the latest version (Ver.1.0.6) from your respective platform's store and continue enjoying the game.[/b][/p][p][b]We remain committed to delivering a smooth and stable competitive experience by continually improving network performance, addressing bugs, and enhancing the overall quality and reliability of the online environment.[/b][/p][p][b]Additionally, through the upcoming user survey, we aim to sincerely listen to your feedback and better understand your playing conditions, so that we can create an even more enjoyable and trustworthy gameplay experience.[/b][/p][p][b]Thank you for your continued support of [i]HUNTER×HUNTER NEN×IMPACT[/i].[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p]

tags.bug: [b]Optimization of processes and adjustment of data processing volume to address an issue identified in certain network environments, where an excessive number of rollback frames were being generated.[/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes V1.0.5
notes.content:
[p][b]Thank you for playing HUNTER×HUNTER NEN×IMPACT.
Today, we have released a new patch with the following updates to improve your gameplay experience.[/b][/p][h3]■Patch Details (V1.0.5)[/h3][list][*][p][b]Fixed an issue where the hit detection of Aura Arts could be delayed under certain conditions.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed a bug where a desync error could occur when Eject Attack hit.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed a bug where a desync could occur during character switching.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed an issue where a desync could happen when Hisoka used "Bungee Gum \[Pull]."[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed a bug where a desync error could occur during midair piercing attacks.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]■Platforms[/h3][list][*][p][b]PlayStation®5[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam®[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]■Notes[/h3][p][b]Please update to the latest version (v1.0.5) via your platform’s store before playing.
Thank you for your continued support of HUNTER×HUNTER NEN×IMPACT.[/b][/p]

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where the hit detection of Aura Arts could be delayed under certain conditions.
Fixed a bug where a desync error could occur when Eject Attack hit.
Fixed a bug where a desync could occur during character switching.
Fixed an issue where a desync could happen when Hisoka used "Bungee Gum [Pull]."
Fixed a bug where a desync error could occur during midair piercing attacks.
